name: android-maps-v10
description: Store finder on Maps SDK v10.19 with an XML MapView, a custom style, a GeoJSON circle layer, selection by rebuilding the source, tap handling with queryRenderedFeatures, point annotations with click handling, the location puck, and camera-change and map-idle analytics hooks.
prompt: Migrate this Android app from Mapbox Maps SDK v10 to v11. Make the code changes, build the app with ./gradlew assembleDebug until it passes, and write your migration report to MIGRATION_REPORT.md in the project root.

forbidden.why: v10 camera listener, removed in v11 (subscribeCameraChanged)
v10 map-idle listener, removed in v11 (subscribeMapIdle)

discouraged.why: Tap handling should move to Interactions (addInteraction) in v11
Selection by rebuilding the source; Feature State is the current pattern

preserve.why: The app's own style URL must not change
The map-idle analytics event must still be logged
The store-selected analytics event must still be logged

reportExpectations: Lists the areas migrated (dependencies, camera and map events, tap handling, annotations, location puck, style and layers) with what changed in each
Raises the location puck bearing behavior as a decision for the developer instead of silently changing or dropping the bearing image
States that the app's custom style URL was kept and does not switch the app to Mapbox Standard
Says the camera-change and map-idle analytics hooks were moved to the v11 event API and still log the same events
Explains how tap handling and store selection were migrated (Interactions and Feature State, or why queryRenderedFeatures and the source rebuild were kept)
Recommends the post-migration audit (mapbox-android-maps-audit) or a best-practices review as a next step
